source.problem: Dowding, Pilch & Hills, 'Formulation of the thermal problem', Comput. Methods Appl. Mech. Engrg. 197 (2008)
source.experimental_data_digitized_from: Chantrasmi, Constantine, Etemadi, Iaccarino & Wang, 'Uncertainty quantification in simple linear and non-linear problems', CTR Annual Research Briefs 2006, Fig. 3 (top)
source.note: Raw numeric ensembles are not openly available; the values below were DIGITIZED from a published vector plot and carry an estimated reading uncertainty of order +/-10-15 K on top of the genuine experiment-to-experiment scatter. Suitable for a physics sanity check, NOT for high-precision validation.

model.equation: T(x,t) = T0 + (q*L/k)*[ k*t/(rho_cp*L^2) + 1/3 - x/L + x^2/(2 L^2) - (2/pi^2) * sum_{n>=1} (1/n^2) exp(-n^2 pi^2 k t/(rho_cp L^2)) cos(n pi x/L) ]
model.boundary_conditions: constant heat flux q applied at x=0; insulated (adiabatic) at x=L

nominal_properties.note: k backed out from CTR Fig. 4 (measured k rises ~0.049->0.075 W/mK over 0-1000 C; mean ~0.06); rho_cp chosen so Eq(1) reproduces the mean profile / experimental points at t=1000 s.
